Module com.example.miniproyecto_50zo
Package com.example.miniproyecto_50zo.controller

Class MachineTurnRunner

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto_50zo.controller.MachineTurnRunner
public class MachineTurnRunner extends Object
Handles the full turn sequence for a machine player in the Cincuentazo game using two background threads to simulate thinking and drawing delays. All model and UI updates are dispatched to the JavaFX Application Thread via Platform.runLater(java.lang.Runnable).

  • Method Details

    • runTurn

      public void runTurn(Player machine, MachineTurnRunner.OnTurnFinished onTurnFinished)
      Starts the machine player's turn asynchronously. Waits between 2 and 4 seconds before playing a card, then proceeds to the draw phase.
      Parameters:
      machine - the machine player whose turn it is
      onTurnFinished - callback invoked when the full turn is complete

    • runDrawPhase

      private void runDrawPhase(Player machine, MachineTurnRunner.OnTurnFinished onTurnFinished)
      Starts the draw phase of the machine's turn asynchronously. Waits between 1 and 2 seconds before drawing a card, then invokes the turn-finished callback.
      Parameters:
      machine - the machine player drawing a card
      onTurnFinished - callback invoked after the card is drawn

    • sleepFor

      private void sleepFor(int minMs, int rangeMs)
      Pauses the current thread for a random duration between minMs and minMs + rangeMs milliseconds.
      Parameters:
      minMs - the minimum sleep duration in milliseconds
      rangeMs - the additional random range in milliseconds
